texts.preamble: M/S Glaxosmithkline Consumer ... vs State Of Uttarakhand & Others on 21 February, 2014 Author: Sudhanshu Dhulia Bench: Sudhanshu Dhulia In The High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital Writ Petition No. 315 of 2014 M/s GlaxoSmithKline Consumer HealthCare Ltd. ..............Petitioner Versus State of Uttarakhand & others ..........Respondents Hon'ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J. (Oral)
texts.facts: Petitioner is a Company which is engaged, inter alia, in manufacturing of food products. The proceedings under Section 68 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 is pending before the Adjudicating Officer which is Additional District Magistrate, Haridwar. The concerned Food Safety Officer has made allegation that there are false claim on the label of the food which is manufactured by the petitioner. During the course of the proceedings the reports by the Food Analyst and Designated Officer, Food Analyst & Director Referral Laboratory have been asked. 4. The petitioner sought cross-examination of certain authorities, a request which has been only partly allowed as he was allowed to cross-examine one person but the request to cross-examine another person has been declined. Therefore, on principle it cannot be the case, at this stage, whether "cross-examination" in these proceedings can at all be allowed as "cross-examination" in at least one case has been allowed. 5.
